entities.name: Siege of Maiozamalcha

entities.summary: During the siege of Maiozamalcha, 8 May 363 CE, the Roman army under Emperor Julian stormed, pillaged, and destroyed the city of Maiozamalcha, before continuing onward to the Sasanian capital of Ctesiphon.
